content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was absent, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A necessity appeal has already been attempted, while resubmission or another appeal without a current denial would violate or fail payer rules; patient billing is not supported as contractual patient liability. No available automated action can properly progress the balance, so specialist review is required."}
